build_CLIP_model: build a CLIP model with a SpaceTimeTransformer vision encoder and OpenAI CLIP text transformer
build_CLIP_HF_model: build a CLIP_HF model using a HuggingFace DistilBert text encoder and a vision model
build_VCLM_model: build a VCLM model with a CLIP vision encoder and a gated GPT-2 text decoder
build_VideoClassifier: build a VideoClassifier model with a vision encoder and linear classification head
get_loss_for_model: get the appropriate loss function for a CLIP or VCLM model given training args
